description: On June 6, 1944, young Americans attacked the Nazi’s on the coast of France and proved George Washington right about everything he believed a free people had to be willing to do. 82 years later, we owe them more than memory.
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Campaign to Elect Cory Maloy
title: They Answered the Call: A D-Day Tribute, 82 Years Later | The 52 Report
